reference_metric_audit.usage: Original/common-support AUC and event/source integrity; prior quantile-matched AUC is superseded for this illustration

protocol_notes.support: Intersection of each original class's [0.005,0.995] weighted energy quantiles; independent of matching-bin width
protocol_notes.binning: Canonical zero-anchored 5 keV grid slice obtained by make_fixed_energy_bins([L,U],5,'keV')
protocol_notes.target: Class fractions use all common-support events BEFORE sparse-bin exclusion. Invalid bins get zero target; normalize the retained overlap masses.
protocol_notes.weights: Original unit weights; matched event weight = target_mass / original class-bin count; zero outside common support or in bins with fewer than 20 events of either class
protocol_notes.adapter: The canonical public evaluator rejects any original finite energy above 3000 keV before trimming. This adapter instead keeps all original energies unchanged for inclusive ROC, computes original common support, and applies the canonical grid only on that support. No energy is clipped. Here C lies within [0,3000], so all >3000 events are naturally outside C with zero matching weight.
protocol_notes.bin_boundaries: [5k,5(k+1)); 3000 belongs to final global bin; an internal-edge observation enters the bin starting there. Common support additionally requires L<=E<=U, so the first/last grid bins can be partially occupied.
protocol_notes.coverage: Retained original base mass divided by original finite-energy base mass, not matched weight and not common-support mass. Both classes must retain >=0.5 and >=2 valid bins are required except for constant energy.
protocol_notes.normalization: Original plotted densities use all original class events as denominator. Matched plotted densities use the class's total matched weight.
protocol_notes.residual: Matching equalizes mass in every retained 5 keV bin. The aligned 50 keV display bins are sums of 5 keV bins and therefore match as well. The continuous energy score can retain small within-5-keV differences.
protocol_notes.auc_scope: matched_auc is the raw weighted diagnostic value for plotting; formal_matched_auc is separately gated. common_support_unweighted_auc includes all C bins, while retained_unweighted_auc includes only valid matching bins.
protocol_notes.uncertainty: Deterministic all-event illustration; no bootstrap intervals or multiple-seed averages

canonical_crosscheck.coverage_warning: Canonical cross-check coverage has C-subset denominators and is NOT the full-population reporting gate.

threshold.selected_by: fixed illustration; not optimized on test

independence_protocol.source: Preserved separate score-stability calculation from the audited original events; eight per-class quantile bins, unrelated to the new 5 keV matching

display.roc_sampling: Deterministic linearly spaced full-curve indices, capped at 2500 points per curve; AUC uses full curves
